title: Code Audit Findings
description: Structured findings produced by the code-audit methodology. Each finding is one concrete, verifiable issue tied to a location in the audited repo.

repo.description: Absolute path or identifier of the audited repository.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the audit was produced.

location.description: file:line or file:start-end (relative to repo root). Use 'repo-wide' only when genuinely not localizable.

dimension.description: Which audit dimension this finding belongs to.

confidence.description: How sure are we the finding is real after verification.

evidence.description: Concrete proof: the offending code, a trace, or the reasoning that the verifier could not refute.

recommendation.description: Specific, actionable fix or next step.

refuted.description: Set true by the verification pass when the finding was disproven. Refuted findings should be dropped from the final report.

refutation_note.description: Why the verifier refuted or downgraded the finding.
